title: WAIKE Technology Discovery Workshop
prerequisites: A permitted device and browser, plain-text editor and file manager
Permission to save small fictional files
An accessibility helper or instructor support when needed
objectives: Locate, rename and reopen a fictional saved file
Restore unchanged bytes from a preserved copy
Separate observations from guesses and protect private information
Calculate a changed capacity case and explain a safe action
Demonstrate a fresh task and explain the method to a reviewer
staffing: Lead instructor plus assistant recommended for 25; confirm observed-assessment time and accommodations before accepting a booking.
completionClaim: Workshop participation and criterion evidence only; no WAIKE course completion, certification or occupational-readiness claim.
softwareLicense: Repository license applies to code; this does not license publication prose or artwork.
sourcePolicy: Delivery orchestration only. Teach and evaluate through the existing GENERAL_IT Digital Confidence guide, grader and Hub rubric. Do not copy their answers or create another curriculum.
